title: Robot reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Doot's body -->
  <rect x='36' y='58' width='28' height='26' rx='7' fill='#5AC8E8'/>
  <rect x='40' y='64' width='20' height='12' rx='4' fill='#7FDCF2'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <rect x='26' y='64' width='10' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4BB4D4'/>
  <rect x='64' y='64' width='10' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4BB4D4'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='8' fill='#4BB4D4'/>
  <!-- head with screen -->
  <rect x='28' y='20' width='44' height='34' rx='9' fill='#5AC8E8'/>
  <rect x='33' y='25' width='34' height='24' rx='6' fill='#14213D'/>
  <!-- eyes on screen, glowing happy, looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='35' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='35' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='36.5' r='1.4' fill='#14213D'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36.5' r='1.4' fill='#14213D'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 45 54 42' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='12' stroke='#4BB4D4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='3.5' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <!-- open book pages -->
    <path d='M22 78 L50 74 L50 88 L22 92 Z' fill='#FFF7E0'/>
    <path d='M78 78 L50 74 L50 88 L78 92 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- page lines -->
    <line x1='27' y1='80' x2='46' y2='77' stroke='#D9C9A3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='27' y1='84' x2='46' y2='81' stroke='#D9C9A3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='73' y2='80' stroke='#D9C9A3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='81' x2='73' y2='84' stroke='#D9C9A3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- book cover -->
    <path d='M18 80 L50 75 L50 90 L18 95 Z' fill='#E63946'/>
    <path d='M82 80 L50 75 L50 90 L82 95 Z' fill='#D62839'/>
    <!-- spine -->
    <line x1='50' y1='75' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#A4161A' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4BB4D4'/>
  <rect x='52' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4BB4D4'/>
</svg>
